messages:
kelsey: Quick FYI — Marta Martinez (contractor) confirmed last day = 2026-04-10 CET. Need to align on benefits end, COBRA eligibility, SSO deprovision timing, laptop return logistics, and final paycheck/expenses. Can folks chime in with owners?

jamal: Do we have her on our benefits roster? I thought contractors were on a third-party plan. cc @lia-benefits. If she's not on Redwood benefits, COBRA won't apply.

lia-benefits: Confirming: Marta was on the 'Redwood Contractor Plus' add-on (we cover a subset). She has medical through the vendor until 2026-04-30 per the vendor feed. She may be eligible for a COBRA-like continuation via vendor — we need to send the vendor the termination date this week.

adrian-manager: For knowledge transfer, we need access for 48h after last day to finish a handoff with infra team. Can IT allow an access exception until 2026-04-12? Marta will be on-call for final doc reviews.

it-ops-bot: New ticket created: IT-2026-451 — Request: temporary access extension for user marta.martinez until 2026-04-12. Assigned to @it-ops. ETA for response: 24h.

it-ops-bot: Note: Standard offboard flow removes SSO on the last business day end-of-day in their primary timezone unless an exception is approved.

it-ops-bot: To approve temporary access, a manager or people-ops must reply with "approve access exception" in this thread.

linda-finance: Payroll note: final paycheck cutoff is 2026-04-05 for the 04/10 termination (semi-monthly run). Any outstanding expenses need receipts by 2026-04-03 to make the final run; reimbursements after that go in next cycle. Marta — can you upload receipts to Expensify by Tue 4/3?

marta: Yep, uploading tonight. Also, laptop return — I'm in Lisbon. Do we cover return shipping? Last time contractor shipping was reimbursed.

lia-benefits: Vendor requires termination date + reason. I'll draft the vendor notice. COBRA-equivalent info will come from them; we should forward it to Marta when we get it.

kelsey: Thanks. @linda-finance will confirm shipping policy. @adrian-manager please confirm if you approve the 48h access exception so IT can action.

adrian-manager: I approve access exception for 48h. approve access exception

it-ops-bot: Access extension approved by adrian-manager. IT ticket updated: temporary SSO exception until 2026-04-12 23:59 CET. Please note we will still remove keys, tokens, and 3rd-party service access unless listed in the exception doc.

linda-finance: We do cover prepaid return shipping for international contractors. Marta — please use this address label template and drop the tracking link in this thread when you ship:``` 
Ship to:
Redwood Inference — Asset Returns
c/o Logistics Team
120 Tech Park Ave
Oakland, CA 94607
```

marta: Thanks — will ship via DHL tomorrow and paste tracking here. Also, is there any paperwork for equity/bonus? I'm on a short contractor grant, vesting was completed last quarter AFAIK.

kelsey: I'll confirm equity status with Comp Ops and circle back. For bonuses, none pending on our side.

lia-benefits: I'll follow up with vendor once I send termination. Marta — expect vendor email about continuation options within 7 business days.

kelsey: Final checklist for this thread: 1) lia-benefits sends vendor termination notice (today) 2) adrian-manager approved access exception (done) 3) IT to execute SSO exception & remove tokens on 4/12 (in ticket) 4) linda-finance to process final payroll and reimbursements if receipts by 4/3 5) Marta to ship laptop and post tracking (Marta) 6) kelsey to confirm equity status. If anyone needs to add, reply here. :thumbsup:

marta: Tracking: DHL 1234 5678 9012 — ship date 2026-03-29. Thanks all for the smooth wrap.

it-ops-bot: Update: IT-2026-451 marked "in-progress". Scheduled token rotation and key revoke for 2026-04-12 12:00 UTC.

kelsey: Closing loop — vendor notified, finance has receipts deadline on 4/3, IT scheduled, laptop tracking noted, equity check pending. I'll post final confirmation here once comp ops responds. Appreciated everyone. :heart:
